Study and research in the heart of Europe! As an international university with an excellent reputation, Goethe University offers a wide range of options.
All important information regarding your path to us has been summarized: from admission requirements and application to language skills.
The Global Office supports international exchange and scholarship students during their studies at Goethe University from preparation to personal support on-site in Frankfurt.
The Goethe Welcome Centre has compiled important information and services for international postdoctoral researchers, doctoral candidates, and professors at Goethe University.
From initial counseling to the buddy program: Goethe University offers services for study applications, scholarships, residence rights, and much more - for a successful start in Frankfurt.
The International Career Service Rhein-Main helps you successfully navigate the path from study to work in the German job market.
